name: High-Risk elites respawn after 45 to 60 minutes
contract: Requires Bloodforged.Enable = 1 with the default Bloodforged.HighRiskEliteEntries and Bloodforged.HighRiskEliteRespawnMinutes = "45 60". A High-Risk elite (Construct Surgeon 918530, spawn 9185300, own respawn 10 minutes) killed by a player who is not High-Risk respawns 45 to 60 minutes later.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the elite is spawned
Respawn is 45 to 60 minutes, not its own 10
